answer_1.quote: We evaluate how often each model generates toxic continuations… using prompts from the Real‑ToxicityPrompts dataset…; we also evaluate on the NewSum summarization task using ROUGE‑L.

answer_2.quote: We compute the probability one of these generations per prompt is toxic… using the Perspective API score ≥0.5; summarization is evaluated with ROUGE‑L; QA performance is measured with F1; toxicity identification uses AUC‑ROC.
